items.title: Southern Gas Markets Bring the Heat to a Lukewarm Outlook
items.summary: Natural gas spot prices strengthened across much of the Gulf Coast and Southeast on Tuesday, with Florida markets posting some of the day's largest gains amid stronger LNG feedgas demand and rising pipeline deliveries.

items.title: November Natural Gas Refuses to Go Quietly Into Expiration
items.summary: Natural gas futures found some relief Tuesday from short covering ahead of the November contract’s expiration, with modestly cooler weather model revisions and a rebound in LNG feedgas demand offering support after a steep selloff.

items.title: Western Canadian Natural Gas Prices Slide as Record Production Overwhelms Demand
items.summary: Western Canadian natural gas prices are sliding under the weight of record production, ample storage inventories and pipeline constraints, leaving Alberta and British Columbia (BC) awash in supply as the winter heating season approaches.

items.title: Freeport LNG Feedgas Cuts Knock US Demand From Recent Highs
items.summary: Natural gas deliveries to Freeport LNG stayed sharply curtailed Tuesday after nearly halting Monday, shrinking a major outlet for Texas Gulf Coast supply.

items.title: Iran War Adds $20B-Plus to EU Natural Gas Bill, Increases Reliance on US LNG
items.summary: The Iran war has added tens of billions of dollars to the European Union’s (EU) natural gas import bill, boosted its reliance on US LNG and left the continent’s storage inventories at the lowest point in years, the bloc’s energy watchdog said Tuesday

items.title: Natural Gas Prices Diverge as November Contract Approaches Expiry
items.summary: Natural gas futures on the New York Mercantile Exchange varied by contract at midday as traders sized up waning weather demand, rising production and LNG strength.

items.title: Will Technical Support Extend a Lifeline to December Natural Gas Futures?
items.summary: December natural gas futures move to the front of the curve after Wednesday’s settlement, and as that moment nears, the contract is under pressure from bearish weather forecasts and looking for technical support.

items.title: Bulls, Bears Wrestle for Control as Natural Gas Futures Knock on Winter’s Door
items.summary: Natural gas futures searched for new direction early Tuesday as the November contract neared expiration, with LNG demand holding strong for bulls but benign weather firmly on the side of bears.
